veranderings.voor: Party skuilings is natuurlik en ander
veranderings.na: Party skuilings is natuurlik, en ander
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
The lesson refers to an animal as 'hy/hom/sy' elsewhere (hom, sy nes); 'dit' here breaks the pronoun reference.

veranderings.voor: 'n Skulp word nie gebou soos 'n nes nie maar groei
veranderings.na: 'n Skulp word nie soos 'n nes gebou nie, maar groei
veranderings.rede: The comparison belongs before the participle inside the negation, and a comma before the contrasting 'maar' makes the sentence easier to read.
More natural word order: the object comes before the place adverb.

veranderings.voor: Party mense pak die heining van klip en ander van takke met dorings aan.
veranderings.na: Party mense pak die heining van klip, en ander maak dit van takke met dorings.
veranderings.rede: The split verb 'pak ... aan' reads as 'aanpak' (tackle), and stacking does not suit thorn branches; give the second clause its own verb and the AWS comma.

veranderings.na: staan binne in hul eie hokkies
veranderings.rede: 'eie' needs a possessive here; 'in eie hokkies' is clipped and unidiomatic.
The sentence is a contrast marked by 'wel', so 'maar' fits; two full clauses take the AWS comma.

veranderings.voor: dra iets swaar of dit hou
veranderings.na: dra iets swaars, of dit hou
veranderings.rede: After 'iets' the adjective takes -s ('iets swaars'), and 'of' joining two full clauses takes the AWS comma.
'maak so ook' is awkward; 'vorm op dieselfde manier' says the same thing naturally.

veranderings.voor: lê teen mekaar en jy kan
veranderings.na: lê teen mekaar, en jy kan
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Nie elke skuiling pas in een groep nie
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
'binnehou' is a compound verb and is written as one word when it is not split.

veranderings.voor: Klip hou jare lank en 'n klipmuur
veranderings.na: Klip hou jare lank, en 'n klipmuur
